Item.Description: A transparency slide showing the left side of a freshly painted carousel pig that is suspended on a pole with a white backdrop. The pig ranges in color from dark brown to almost white at the hooves. The saddle is light brown with a black and yellow border. The saddle blanket is black with yellow details. The tack is red with yellow clasps and the saddle strap is blue with yellow and darker blue details. The image has some black spots. The eyes of the pig are unfinished. The slide reads “PULLEN PARK CAROUSEL PULLEN PARK 16B” at the top and “RALEIGH NC WAKE CO 9-9-81" at the bottom. There is another date stamped over “RALEIGH NC” but it is too faded to be legible.

Title: Pullen Park Carousel - PPC2019.001.583
